Language familiarity 5.00/5 and implementation-complexity rubric 2.50/5; short delivery/beginner-complexity and manual Markdown-conversion penalties are explicit heuristics; supported server-language depth 1 gives ecosystem reuse bonus 0.
Static delivery avoids application writes; embedded-writer and growth triggers are ordinal review heuristics, not published capacity limits.
No latency SLA or measured framework throughput is credited; embedded-write concurrency is a review heuristic. Low-memory clients require measurement, not an assumed framework benchmark.
Operational burden 1/5+; no existing-system reuse bonus. Server ecosystem reuse bonus 0; fewer self-operated systems are favored without DevOps. Additional service operating penalty 0.
Baseline configured controls: 3; explicit reviewed tenant isolation: 4. No certification/audit credit is assigned.

warnings.message: The proposed regional log/file archive requires an implemented, pinned and tested S3-compatible exporter/SDK, IAM, retry/backpressure, deletion retention and restore workflow. The reviewed OpenTelemetry S3 exporter is alpha; no durable local worker disk, indexed log search, archive delivery or successful restore is assumed verified. Shared one-GiB container capacity and end-to-end availability remain unmeasured.

This paid managed tier is a planning proposal, not validated capacity or an availability SLA. Validate pool limits, concurrent clients, CPU/memory, backup restore and the requested p95/availability before deployment; no automatic HA replicas are assumed.
99.9% is a target, not a product guarantee. The cost model provisions redundancy assumptions; service terms, failover and workload behavior still require verification.
Legacy reuse requires version/EOL, license, network, schema and identity integration checks; no migration or connectivity is assumed verified.

AngularJS upstream support ended 2022-01; found in AngularJS admin portal. Do not retain it as the recommended production runtime. Plan migration/isolation and review compatibility. Evidence: https://docs.angularjs.org/misc/version-support-status

Python 2 upstream support ended 2020-01-01; found in Python 2.7 report service. Do not retain it as the recommended production runtime. Plan migration/isolation and review compatibility. Evidence: https://www.python.org/doc/sunset-python-2/

Planning bands combine published reference rates and explicitly authored allowances; they are not regional provider quotes or measured workload capacity. Validate sizing, merchant/SMS eligibility, storage, requests and current tariffs before purchase.
